* '''Playtest''' ([[Coruscant: 500 Republica (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Corsucant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.”
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Corsucant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.” '''What changed:''' before release: the art credit “Image approval of DanOcean@Deviantart pending” became “Image courtesy of DanOcean@Deviantart”, the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added, and the card was re-rendered with sharper graphics; same words (including the misspelling “Corsucant”).
*: [[File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant: 500 Republica (Errata)]], 2 August 2019): Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscant500republica.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Corsucant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.” '''What changed:''' the image was re-uploaded on release day turned 90° (stored as a landscape site card, Holotable commit “Flipped sites”); same picture and words. Listed as its own version under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 (18:48: every published image that differs from the previous one is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Coruscant: 500 Republica (Errata 2)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-coruscant500republica.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscant500republica.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “May not be separated from Coruscant: Private Platform.” Dark Side: “Grievous moves from here for free.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: the misspelling “Corsucant: Private Platform” became “Coruscant: Private Platform”; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”). '''PC transcription error:''' the words changed but the card prints no errata mark (this is errata version 2 by release order, PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
